name: Axya
description: 为大型制造企业提供AI驱动的采购自动化平台,集成现有ERP系统,通过AI处理采购订单、报价和供应商沟通,网络覆盖超8万家供应商
description_en: AI-powered procurement automation platform for large manufacturing firms that integrates with existing ERP systems, applies AI to purchase orders, quotes, and supplier communication, with a network of over 80,000 suppliers
why_matters: 针对制造业采购仍依赖邮件和电子表格的痛点,Axya通过AI实现风险检测和自动化工作流,客户包括GE航空航天和MDA Space等企业级制造商,年度经常性收入同比翻倍且净收入留存率达140%
why_matters_en: Addresses the manufacturing procurement pain point of reliance on email and spreadsheets by applying AI for risk detection and automated workflows; serves enterprise customers including GE Aerospace and MDA Space, with ARR doubling year-over-year and net revenue retention near 140%
latest_news: 2026年9月完成1700万加元A轮融资(1200万股权+500万债务),由多伦多McRock Capital领投,Yamaha Motor Ventures、加拿大商业发展银行等跟投,计划年底前团队扩至55人并深化美国市场
latest_news_en: Closed $17M CAD Series A in September 2026 ($12M equity + $5M debt) led by McRock Capital, with Yamaha Motor Ventures, BDC, and Real Ventures participating; plans to grow team from 40 to 55 by year-end and expand US presence
source_title: Axya closes $17-million Series A to modernize manufacturing procurement

evidence.quote: Montréal-based supply chain software startup Axya has secured $17 million CAD in equity and debt Series A funding to automate procurement for manufacturers with the help of AI. The round consisted of $12 million in equity primary capital and $5 million in venture debt from CIBC Innovation Banking. The equity portion was led by Toronto's McRock Capital
Axya has grown capital efficiently, doubling its ARR year-over-year while posting net revenue retention near 140 percent

name: Kontext
description: 为AI智能体提供运行时安全控制平台,帮助组织监控和控制AI智能体的操作行为,防止未经授权的操作
description_en: Runtime security platform for AI agents that gives organizations visibility and control over AI agent actions, helping prevent unauthorized operations
why_matters: 解决AI智能体获得更大访问权限和自主性后的安全风险,通过实时评估智能体活动并执行安全策略,在操作执行前进行控制,获得a16z CSX等知名投资机构支持
why_matters_en: Addresses security risks as AI agents gain greater access and autonomy, controls agent actions in real-time against security policies before execution, backed by notable investors including a16z CSX
latest_news: 获得400万美元融资,由42CAP领投,a16z CSX和HTGF跟投
latest_news_en: Raised $4 million in funding led by 42CAP, with backing from a16z CSX and HTGF
source_title: Kontext raises $4M for runtime security platform for AI agents

evidence.quote: AI security company Kontext has raised $4 million in funding to expand its runtime security platform for AI agents. The financing was led by 42CAP, with backing from a16z CSX and HTGF.
The founders have backgrounds in secure computing, applied cryptography and AI systems.

name: Duqu
description: 为企业提供针对未付B2B发票的短期垫付服务,并开发AI驱动的承保技术,自动化约95%的信用评估流程,24小时内完成资金转账
description_en: Provides short-term advances against outstanding B2B invoices and develops AI-powered underwriting technology that automates around 95% of the credit assessment process, with funds transferred within 24 hours
why_matters: 解决荷兰企业现金流痛点(46%的B2B发票逾期支付),其专有AI承保引擎实现95%自动化评估,可作为白标解决方案供银行和贷款机构使用
why_matters_en: Addresses Dutch business cash flow pain point (46% of B2B invoices paid after due date) with proprietary AI underwriting engine achieving 95% automation, deployable as white-label solution for banks and lenders
latest_news: 2026年9月获得150万欧元pre-seed轮融资,投资方包括Curiosity VC和No Such Ventures
latest_news_en: Raised €1.5M pre-seed funding in September 2026 from Curiosity VC and No Such Ventures
source_title: Duqu raises €1.5M to give businesses faster access to working capital

evidence.quote:
Amsterdam-based fintech Duqu has raised €1.5
million in pre-seed funding from Curiosity VC and No Such Ventures

Duqu has
spent the past year and a half developing its proprietary AI underwriting
engine, which currently automates around 95 per cent of the credit assessment
process. The technology is modular and can be used outside Duqu's own platform,
allowing banks, lenders and leasing companies to deploy it as a white-label
solution

name: Feather Robotics
description: 开发模块化人形机器人硬件平台,允许开发者根据不同用例定制硬件(如调整手臂长度),可运行Nvidia、Skild或Physical Intelligence等主流机器人AI模型,售价3万美元
description_en: Develops a modular humanoid robot hardware platform that allows developers to customize hardware for different use cases (such as adjusting arm lengths), capable of running leading robotics AI models from Nvidia, Skild, or Physical Intelligence, priced at $30,000
why_matters: 以3万美元价格提供可定制的模块化人形机器人平台,成本约为中国竞品Unitree H2 Edu的一半,已实现超100万美元收入,机器人在餐厅和实验室实际部署,定位为机器人领域的'Android'生态系统
why_matters_en: Offers a customizable modular humanoid robot platform at $30,000, about half the price of Chinese competitor Unitree H2 Edu, has surpassed $1 million in revenue with robots deployed in restaurants and labs, positioning as the 'Android of robotics' ecosystem
latest_news: 2025年成立后获得Gradient Ventures领投的760万美元pre-seed轮融资,已开始销售并实现超100万美元收入,机器人在餐厅担任厨师和实验室清洁工作
latest_news_en: Founded in 2025, raised $7.6 million pre-seed round led by Gradient Ventures, began selling to customers and surpassed $1 million in revenue, with robots working as cooks in restaurants and cleaning science labs
source_title: Meet Feather, the startup building the ‘Android of robotics’ for developers

evidence.quote: Gradient Ventures, which backed Feather at its inception, leading the startup's previously announced $7.6 million pre-seed round
Parsa Bakhtiari (pictured above, right), a former Tesla Model 3 engineer who at one point reported directly to Elon Musk
The startup has already begun selling to customers, surpassing $1 million in revenue

name: Go.AI
description: 为银行和医疗机构提供本地部署的私有AI基础设施,确保敏感数据不离开客户安全环境的软硬件一体化解决方案
description_en: On-premises AI infrastructure provider for banks and healthcare providers, combining hardware and software so sensitive data does not leave customers' secure environments
why_matters: 在AI监管合规领域提供差异化方案,通过本地部署架构解决金融和医疗等受监管行业无法将敏感数据发送到云端的核心痛点,已获8500万美元A轮融资并拥有超过50人团队
why_matters_en: Addresses a critical pain point for regulated industries by enabling AI deployment without sending sensitive data to the cloud, secured $85M Series A with over 50 team members serving banks and healthcare providers
latest_news: 2026年9月完成8500万美元A轮融资,由Updata Partners领投,资金将用于扩展工程团队和Go.OS软件及硬件产品线
latest_news_en: Closed $85M Series A in September 2026 led by Updata Partners to support engineering team expansion and development of Go.OS software and hardware line
source_title: Pair of $400m rounds drive this week’s FinTech funding

evidence.quote: Go.AI, a Chicago-based provider of on-premises AI infrastructure for banks, healthcare providers and other regulated organisations, has closed an $85m Series A funding round.
Go.AI co-founder and CEO David Moscatelli said, 'When Lisa Gillespie and I cofounded the company, we were two people with a big idea. Today we have over 50 team members'

name: Baselayer
description: 为金融机构提供身份验证和风险基础设施,专注于开发验证自主AI代理在交易前的身份、授权和可信度的技术
description_en: Identity and risk infrastructure provider developing technology for verifying autonomous AI agents before they transact, serving one in five U.S. financial institutions
why_matters: 在AI代理商务化浪潮来临前前瞻性布局信任基础设施,已服务五分之一美国金融机构,获3500万美元A轮融资,针对代理交易验证这一新兴需求提供差异化解决方案
why_matters_en: Proactively building trust infrastructure for agentic commerce before widespread adoption, already serving one in five U.S. financial institutions with $35M Series A to address emerging agent verification needs
latest_news: 2026年9月获得3500万美元A轮融资,由M13领投,资金将用于扩展身份和风险基础设施并开发AI代理验证技术
latest_news_en: Secured $35M Series A in September 2026 led by M13 to expand identity and risk infrastructure and develop technology for verifying autonomous AI agents
source_title: Pair of $400m rounds drive this week’s FinTech funding

evidence.quote: Baselayer, an identity and risk infrastructure provider for financial institutions and payments firms, has secured $35m in Series A funding.
The company will use the funding to expand its identity and risk infrastructure as it develops technology for verifying autonomous AI agents before they transact.

name: Kastle
description: 为金融机构构建AI代理的平台,自动化消费者贷款运营,无需替换现有遗留系统即可在现有银行系统之上运行
description_en: Platform building AI agents for financial institutions to automate consumer lending operations on top of existing banking systems without requiring legacy infrastructure replacement
why_matters: 解决金融机构长期面临的技术困境,通过AI代理在不替换核心系统的前提下实现自动化,获2400万美元A轮融资,为北美银行提供渐进式AI转型路径
why_matters_en: Solves financial institutions' longstanding dilemma by enabling AI automation without costly system replacement, secured $24M Series A to provide incremental AI transformation path for North American banks
latest_news: 2026年9月完成2400万美元A轮融资,由Insight Partners领投,资金将用于扩展团队并加速北美市场部署
latest_news_en: Closed $24M Series A in September 2026 led by Insight Partners to grow teams and accelerate rollouts across North America
source_title: Pair of $400m rounds drive this week’s FinTech funding

evidence.quote: Kastle, a start-up building AI agents for financial institutions, has closed a $24m Series A funding round

Kastle provides AI agents that operate on top of existing banking systems to carry out high-volume, repeatable lending tasks without requiring financial institutions to replace their legacy infrastructure.

name: Corridor
description: 为小型企业提供AI驱动的健康保险经纪服务,将企业与持证顾问配对,并使用AI代理处理方案比较、投保和与保险公司联络等任务
description_en: AI-native benefits brokerage serving small businesses, pairing them with licensed advisers while using AI agents to handle carrier comparisons, proposals, enrollment and carrier liaison
why_matters: 针对小型企业健康保险市场的长期服务缺口,通过AI技术将大企业级服务能力下沉至中小企业,获2500万美元种子轮融资,投资方包括OpenAI和Ramp等公司背景的天使投资人
why_matters_en: Addresses small business health insurance service gap by bringing enterprise-grade service to SMBs through AI, raised $25M seed with angels from OpenAI, Ramp, Scale AI and Oscar
latest_news: 2026年9月以2500万美元种子轮融资启动,由Bain Capital Ventures领投,资金将用于扩展AI驱动的经纪平台
latest_news_en: Launched in September 2026 with $25M seed funding led by Bain Capital Ventures to expand AI-powered brokerage platform
source_title: Pair of $400m rounds drive this week’s FinTech funding

evidence.quote: Corridor, an AI-native benefits brokerage serving small businesses, has launched with $25m in seed funding.
Bain Capital Ventures led the round, with BoxGroup and Definition Capital also participating alongside angel investors from companies including OpenAI, Ramp, Scale AI and Oscar.

name: Hang Ten Systems
description: 为大型企业提供AI驱动的软件构建和现代化服务,专注于将AI应用于复杂的企业软件开发流程,帮助年收入超过100亿美元的公司进行AI战略咨询和软件系统建设
description_en: AI-powered enterprise software development and modernization service for large corporations, focusing on applying AI to complex enterprise software processes and helping companies with over $10 billion in annual revenue with AI strategy and system building
why_matters: 在成立仅四个月内获得总计8500万美元种子轮融资,并已签署多个七位数合同、正在洽谈八位数交易,客户遍及美国、欧洲、中东和亚洲,包括Fresenius Kabi、沙特阿美和西门子能源。创始人Vishal Sikka曾担任Infosys CEO,公司声称能够用2-4人团队完成以往需要30人的项目,承诺为客户在成本或速度上实现10倍改进
why_matters_en: Raised $85 million total seed funding in just four months since founding, secured multiple seven-figure contracts pursuing eight-figure deals, with customers spanning the U.S., Europe, Middle East, and Asia including Fresenius Kabi, Saudi Aramco, and Siemens Energy. Founded by former Infosys CEO Vishal Sikka, the company claims to complete projects with 2-4 people that previously required ~30, promising customers 10x improvement in cost, speed, or both
latest_news: 2026年9月在首轮种子融资结束五周后再次获得5300万美元融资,由淡马锡早期投资平台Xora领投,使总融资额达到8500万美元
latest_news_en: Secured additional $53 million in September 2026, just five weeks after initial seed round, led by Temasek's Xora, bringing total funding to $85 million
source_title: Former Infosys chief's AI startup nabs another $53M

evidence.quote: This new investment round was closed just five weeks after the initial $32 million seed round was closed, the company tells TechCrunch. The fresh investment, led by Temasek's early-stage investment platform Xora, takes Hang Ten's total funding to $85 million.
an AI startup founded by former Infosys CEO Vishal Sikka

Within 25 days of the first meeting with one customer, Hang Ten signed a multimillion-dollar contract to build a mission-critical software system, Sikka said, adding that he had never seen enterprise deals move that quickly.
